ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT made as of the 13th day of January, 2016 by PHIPPS AFFORDABLE HOUSING 13th Floor, New York, New York 10010 (in its capacity as the owner of the Lower Parcel, as hereinafter defined (Lower Parcel Owner"), and in its capacity as the owner of the Airspace Parcel, as hereinafter defined ("Airspace Parcel Owner"). STATEMENT OF FACTS Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the County of New York, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 28 East 29th Street, New York, New York, designated as Lot 56 in Block 858 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the“Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the "Owner Parcel"). The Owner Parcel will be subdivided into two separate tax lots, consisting of the Lower Parcel (as hereinafter defined) and the Airspace Parcel (as hereinafter defined) (the “Tax Lot Subdivision"). Upon completion of the Tax Lot Subdivision, Lower Parcel Owner intends to retain certain land that lies below the Lower Limiting Plane (as hereinafter defined) with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the County of New York, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 28 East 29th Street, New York, New York, currently designated as part of Lot 56 in Block 858 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on improvements, together with any future replacements thereof not prohibited by this Agreement, being herein called the “Lower Parcel Building"). convey to a third-party that certain parcel of air space that lies above the Lower Limiting Plane, currently designated as part of Lot 56 in Block 858 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on Exhibit C annexed hereto (said parcel of air space being herein called the “Airspace Parcel"). By execution of a Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement of even date and contemporaneously herewith, Owner has confirmed that the Lower Parcel and the Airspace Parcel are, and continue to be, a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot"). This Agreement is being executed, acknowledged, delivered and recorded to obtain a tax lot number for the Airspace Parcel from the New York City Department of Finance.            s  rights and obligations in and to the Lower Parcel and the Airspace Parcel and other matters. 1 KL3 3052632.2
